answer: The garden is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the comet. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the cedar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work.
